overview.name: ZEYAD HESHAM
overview.bio: Highly skilled Full-Stack Engineer specializing in scalable REST API design, robust backend architecture using NestJS, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, and modern frontend development with React, HTML, CSS, and Tailwind CSS. Proficient in developing production systems with JWT authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), real-time communication via WebSockets, and geospatial querying. Experienced in optimizing database schema design and orchestrating containerized deployments with Docker, ensuring high performance and security.

experience.title: FULLSTACK ENGINEER (FREELANCE)
experience.description: Designed and built the complete backend for a production desktop ERP suite engineered for industrial aluminum and glass fabricators. Orchestrates end-to-end manufacturing lifecycles, cut plan scrap optimization, and automated quotation calculation. Built with NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Docker.
experience.previewCaption: BLUE COAST OS // PRODUCTION RUNTIME DASHBOARD OVERVIEW
highlights: Architected a modular NestJS backend with 15+ domain modules including compounds, buildings, floors, apartments, windows, cut plans, glass batches, accessories, pricing, invoices, reports, weights, PDFs, images, and system configuration.

Created a 3-tier reporting system (system-wide, compound-level, building-level) with aggregated analytics for material consumption, profile usage efficiency, accessory usage, unit counts, and financial summaries.
Engineered a builder-pattern window calculation engine supporting 4 aluminum profile systems (PS 9600, PS 6600, PS 4800, Sonata 45) with configurable sub-types and options.
Generated Arabic RTL PDF reports using pdfmake with Cairo font support, exporting window measurement tables grouped by profile system.
Developed a Best Decreasing Fit bin-packing algorithm for generating optimized aluminum cut plans that minimize material waste, factoring in blade kerf and 45-degree cutting angle adjustments.
Implemented JWT-based authentication with access and refresh token rotation, bcrypt password hashing, and role-based authorization (RBAC) enforced globally via NestJS guards.

Built a pricing engine that computes per-square-meter window pricing by aggregating aluminum weight, glass area, and accessories costs with configurable waste percentages, plus fabrication, installation, transportation, and profit margin calculations.
Managed database schema evolution with TypeORM migrations and seeded reference data for accessories and profile weights via dedicated seed scripts.
Designed an invoicing module with automatic total calculation from window specifications via integration with the pricing engine, supporting invoice lifecycle management.
Containerized the full production stack (NestJS backend, PostgreSQL database, Caddy reverse proxy) using Docker Compose for both development and production environments.

caseStudy.heroSub: An end-to-end desktop ERP software solution engineered to digitize aluminum & glass manufacturing facilities, eliminate profile scrap through linear cut-plan optimization heuristics, and automate multi-system pricing.
caseStudy.overviewCaption: BLUE COAST OS: INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION MANAGEMENT SUITE & OVERVIEW DASHBOARD
caseStudy.runtimeSub: 15+ NESTJS BACKEND DOMAINS • 7,310.6M LINEAR METERS TRACKED

section1.title: Eliminating Material Waste & Manual Estimation
section1.desc: Industrial aluminum fabrication relies on expensive 6.5-meter raw extrusion bars. Traditionally, fabricators calculated window cuts manually using spreadsheets or manual bench chalk. This caused:
section1.bullet1: Up to 20% residual aluminum scrap due to non-optimized cutting combinations.
section1.bullet2: Blade kerf loss (3mm per cut) and 45° angle miter inaccuracies causing misfits.
section1.bullet3: Discrepancies in per-m² price calculations due to volatile raw material market rates.
section1.bullet4: Lag between window specifications and commercial customer invoices.
section1.fig1Caption: FIGURE 1.0: BATCH PRODUCTION SCHEDULING & FABRICATION PROGRESS
section1.fig1Desc: Tracking active manufacturing cut plan batches across compounds, units, and real-time operator progress.

section2.title: Best Decreasing Fit Bin-Packing Engine
section2.desc: How we mathematically optimized bar cutting schedules to save thousands of linear meters of aluminum extrusion.
section2.fig2Caption: FIGURE 2.0: CUT PLAN BAR BIN-PACKING OPTIMIZATION LAYOUT
section2.fig2Desc: Visual cut map showing individual piece assignments per 6.5m stock bar with kerf offset, angle indicators, and scrap percentage calculation.
section2.item1Desc: Subtracts exact saw blade kerf thickness (typically 3mm-4mm) on each cut slice.
section2.item2Desc: Computes true bar lengths factoring in 45° vs 90° profile corner joints.
section2.item3Desc: Re-sorts window schedules across whole batches to fill residual stock segments before opening new bars.
section2.item4Desc: Generates workshop cutting sheets that saw operators follow directly on the fabrication floor.
section2.formulation: Formulation: 1D First-Fit Decreasing (FFD) heuristics with discrete piece sorting across entire building batches against 6,500mm standard extrusion stock.

section3.title: Parametric Window Cost & Quotation Calculator
section3.desc: Dynamic cost aggregation across raw aluminum weight, glass surface area, hardware accessories, and fabrication margins.
section3.lead: Fabricators need instantaneous pricing when bidding on major commercial compounds. The calculation engine uses a builder pattern to dynamically derive the manufacturing cost and selling price per square meter:
section3.item1Desc: Aggregates profile linear weights (kg/m) across frame, sash, interlock, and bead.
section3.item2Desc: Calculates exact glazed area based on sash clearance with single/double-glazed allowance.
section3.item3Desc: Configurable percentage markups for transportation, installation, scrap allowance, and operating margin.
section3.rowExtrusion: Extrusion: Profile linear kg/m × Raw Aluminum EGP/ton
section3.rowGlass: Glass: Clear/Tinted sqm × Per-sqm Sheet Rate
section3.rowAccessories: Accessories: Rollers, wool piles, gaskets, corner joints
section3.rowMarkups: Markups: Configurable scrap %, transport & operating margin
section3.fig3Desc: Allows estimators to specify window model, dimensions, quantity, and profile system to automatically calculate total and per-square-meter manufacturing cost.

section4.title: Site Hierarchy, Invoicing & Reports
section4.desc: From multi-compound architectural breakdowns to bilingual Arabic RTL PDF invoice generation.
section4.fig4Desc: Structures manufacturing orders into Compounds → Buildings → Floors → Apartments → Window schedules, allowing drill-down tracking of material usage per individual flat or building block.
section4.fig5Caption: FIGURE 5.0: COMMERCIAL INVOICING & RTL PDF REPORTS
section4.fig5Desc: Generates commercial invoices linked directly to window cut schedules. Produces Arabic RTL PDF reports using pdfmake with Cairo font integration for workshop and executive client presentations.
